summary: Perform static constraint validation and return the form validity result.

target.notes: Run static constraint validation across candidate controls; invalid controls receive invalid events and the aggregate result is false if any remain invalid.

caveats: Custom validity, disabled/readonly/barred controls, and form-associated custom elements affect the candidate set.

tests.name: required empty control is invalid
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.required=true; f.append(i); console.log(f.checkValidity());

tests.name: invalid event is observable
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.required=true; f.append(i); let n=0; i.addEventListener('invalid',()=>n++); f.checkValidity(); console.log(n);
